original_test_intent: Verify the complete owner-approved GPU sensor population across IB SDR/Sensor List, OOB SDR/Sensor List and BMC Web against the physical GPU/SXM/PCIe inventory, topology and sensor specification.
original_method: Enumerate every required GPU record, bind it to a physical GPU/module/slot/board/zone, classify temperature, power, voltage, presence and health semantics, retain complete aligned IB/OOB inventories and Web rows, and compare values, units, states, thresholds and freshness while preserving fault context.
manual_activity: The owner defines GPU record membership, types, physical map and limits and resolves criteria 3–98; an operator reviews all Web rows, then the owner decides the verdict.
required_inputs: Exact GPU record inclusion list and expected GPU/module count
GPU index to SXM/PCIe module, slot, board and thermal-zone map
Per-record semantic type, units, scaling, ranges, thresholds, states and freshness
IB/OOB/Web aliases and full Web access
Protected credentials, workload/power/thermal context and criteria 3–98 decision
safety_requirements: Use read-only queries with protected credentials
Do not reset, power-cycle, reconfigure or fault-inject a GPU
Do not combine temperature, power, voltage, presence or health records
Do not use the item title as a sensor or truncate evidence
Stop on alarm, missing/duplicate/stale member, wrong GPU identity or channel disagreement
agent_execution_scope: Verify the unique row and collect complete passive inventories
Classify and map every approved GPU record
Normalize per-record values/states and complete Web parity
Report missing/extra/duplicate/stale members, inventory mismatches and alarms
Perform no GPU action, topology decision, criteria invention or DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve GPU population, topology, record types and expected limits
Resolve criteria-number gap and absent-module behavior
Review all evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: ipmitool is relevant, but `sensor get 'Check GPU - GPU'` invents an aggregate record and the head-limited fallback cannot establish the broad source scope or Web parity.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Securely retain full IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists, classify and exact-match every approved GPU record, capture all Web rows and compare through the physical topology and semantic map.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The broad GPU filter, both IB/OOB lists, Web, SPEC comparison, Config-Check and 3/0-minute values remain; log clearing is disabled.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use a per-GPU/per-record matrix of physical identity, semantic type, raw/normalized value or state and timestamp across IB/OOB/Web.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact population, topology and type-aware comparison without changing GPU state.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A single aggregate query can hide a missing GPU and cannot substitute among thermal, power, presence and health evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: GPU numbering, module form factor and cached readings may differ by surface; authoritative aliases and timing rules are required.

project_override_considerations: Grouped GPU records are acceptable only with an approved aggregation contract that still exposes every required module; absent or disabled GPUs need explicit expected-state rules.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and broad-filter/criteria defect record
Versioned GPU inventory, topology and record-type specification
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor lists with timestamps/exits
Every approved GPU record with physical mapping, type, value/unit/state/threshold and Web row
Inventory/missing/duplicate/stale analysis, workload/power/thermal context, criteria decision, no-action/no-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: GPU is an undefined broad population spanning multiple physical modules and incompatible record types, while criteria jump from 2 to 99. DeepSeek replaces it with one invented aggregate sensor and truncated evidence.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Passive collection is feasible; population, topology, type rules, limits and source clarification are supplyable owner inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2038 Wistron-BMC-01057-V002: define the exact GPU sensor population and expected GPU/module count, map each record to GPU/SXM/PCIe module, slot, board or zone, separate temperature/power/voltage/presence/health semantics and limits, and confirm whether Criteria 1, 2, 99 is only misnumbered or Criteria 3–98 are missing.

review_improvement: Expands the GPU scope to every physical module and record type, requires complete three-surface evidence and rejects the synthetic aggregate/truncated shortcut.
independent_technical_reasoning: GPU is an inventory scope, not a single measurement. A temperature value, a power reading and a presence bit have different units and acceptance logic, and each must be tied to the correct physical module. Without that map a apparently healthy aggregate may conceal an absent or alarming GPU, so per-record type and identity reconciliation is necessary.
